name: untitled tag game [beta]
desc:
A work in progress game of Tag with advanced movement including climbing, sliding, rolling, vaulting, swinging, and more! Currently, there are 13+ unique gamemodes, 12+ maps, and more! 

Click to tag C to slide 
C when landing to roll 
Space at an edge to climb 
Space when colliding with a 
SwingBar to swing 

We are currently in development of a full remaster with loads more content and polish. You can access the early version of this in the lobby! 
Please join our Communications Server to provide feedback as we read all of it and it helps us a ton!
